title: Sainsbury’s and Morrisons ‘held talks this year’ on multibillion-pound merger
summary: Deal would have created a supermarket with a market share of 23.6%, still well behind Tesco’s 27.8%
Sainsbury’s held merger talks with rival Morrisons this year to discuss a multibillion-pound deal that would have been the biggest shake-up for UK supermarkets in decades, according to reports.
The two companies held exploratory negotiations, according to the Financial Times and Sky. It is believed they are no longer in live discussions.
summary_zh: 這筆交易將創造一家市場份額為 23.6% 的超市，仍遠遠落後於樂購 (Tesco) 的 27.8%
據報道，塞恩斯伯里今年與競爭對手莫里森舉行了合併談判，討論一項價值數十億英鎊的交易，這將是英國超市幾十年來最大的重組。
根據英國《金融時報》和天空電視台報道，兩家公司進行了探索性談判。據信他們不再參與現場討論。
